success.description: A blast of shadowy wind surrounds you, knocking all other characters in your engagement away from you to close range. They are no longer engaged with you or each other.
A4 As above, and all affected characters are knocked prone. They must spend a manoeuvre to stand up.

boon.description: You may create any number of new engagements out of the affected characters.

success.description: A blast of shadowy wind and black lightning surrounds you, striking each character in your engagement (aside from yourself) for 3+Int {Df} damage.
As above, and ignore each target’s soak value of armour.

boon.description: Borne aloft on your own winds, you may leave the engagement and land somewhere within medium range.

chaosStar.description: 3+ You are struck by Suffer “Your own storm!” 1 wound.
